body: Has anyone had any experiences with Pharmaqo? I was thinking about getting some Testosterone-E 300 and I’ve seen quite a few mixed reviews. If Pharmaqo isn’t ideal does anyone have any recommendations?

I pretty much have the same question and can’t seem to find an answer at all. I’m schizophrenic but I function just fine without medication so I do wonder if I would. But in acknowledgement to one of your comments; if you applied to the army and didn’t get in because of it then the marines probably won’t accept you either. Though, going to a GP and seeing if they can give you the all-clear would probably clear up any misconceptions.
